determinations.result: The public-anchor system is provisionally established as a structured public documentation and bounded-review mechanism. Repository artifacts demonstrate internal representation and validation of governed dockets, reconstruction submissions, correction receipts, and non-authority boundaries. Independent reviewer standing, substantive correctness, neutral reconstruction, government recognition, and certification authority are not established.

No independent external reconstruction has been observed.
No government recognition or certification authority is established.
No canonical hash or signature receipt is bound to the complete self-review package.

limitations: The self-review is issued by the system under review.
Internal validators establish structural agreement only.
No independent external reconstruction is attached.
Publication creates no certification, execution authority, government recognition, or immunity from challenge.
public_verification_instructions: Freeze the referenced repository artifacts and relevant commit, reconstruct TA-14 and ASRO standing from evidence without treating StegVerse determinations as authoritative, disclose reviewer conflicts, preserve divergent results, and submit any correction or supersession request through the published review-governance objects.
